name: aplikasi-purimas-backend
description: Backend REST API server for Aplikasi RT Purimas Tirtajaya with PostgreSQL

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/database', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/database/schema.sql', 'dist/database/schema.sql'); fs.copyFileSync('src/database/seed.sql', 'dist/database/seed.sql');"
